claude_plan.goal: Travel east across the salt marsh to (79,6), away from the croc to the south-west and the baboon-risk rows 0–1. Then take the east zone exit to try a detour toward Red Rock.
claude_plan.guidance: If there is no combat, keep heading east through rows 2–8, staying north of the lake that starts at x35. Once the croc is out of sight, use goto to (79,6). Do not approach the croc; bypass it. If it closes within 8 cells, move E/NE away from it rather than fighting. Fight only a lone baboon. At 8 HP or less, with no enemy adjacent, eat witchwood bark (it confuses). At the east edge, reassess before crossing.

strategy.build_goal: Melee axe marauder: Str 21 bronze battle axe, Heightened Quickness and passive defense. Active abilities (Dismember, Charge, Kindle, laser) can't be executed, and this executor can't spend the mutation point.
strategy.next_upgrades: Hold SP (7) until next level. Then buy Spry (+2 DV, 100 SP) or Axe Cleave (150 SP), then Endurance for Shake It Off. Attribute points go to Toughness first, then Strength.
strategy.resource_policy: Drink fresh water only when thirsty; eat bear jerky when hungry. Eat witchwood bark (3 left) to heal at ≤45% HP only when no enemy is adjacent, because it confuses. Albino regeneration is slow in daylight, so rest is weak. Use a torch at night or underground. Baboons throw stones and roam in packs: fight them one at a time and retreat from groups. Avoid crocs. Below 40% HP, retreat away from enemies.

submitted_modal_responses.dialog_text: A waterhand? Aye. Live and drink, traveller.

offered_choices.label: I am called Jev Opus Mutant.
Can you tell me about your village, Joppa?
I am in search of work.
Your thirst is mine, my water is yours. [begin water ritual; 1 dram of water]

submitted_modal_responses.selected_label: I am in search of work.

submitted_modal_responses.dialog_text:
Aye? I have it, then.

Somethin' is eating our watervine, 'round Beetle Moon. Q-ruun says he saw a creature, spider-like, slinking in the brine. But no cave spider would dare get so near Warden's stomps.

I tasted a bit of red fleck in the pool. Shale, like we find in the soil by Red Rock...

Hike there, will you? To Red Rock. Just about two parasangs north of Joppa.

Kill the vermin and bring one's corpse back, for seein' what it is. Elder will take care to pay you after, waterhand.

executor_contract.moves: Eight compass directions are single steps; an occupied hostile cell may cause melee. Terrain/passability is not guaranteed by a glyph. U/D use native stairs or world-map transitions.
executor_contract.macros: goto/explore/rest are unavailable on the world map and near visible hostiles. goto requires a known cell. Macros stop on danger; budget is game turns, not wall time.
executor_contract.items: Use only current item IDs and listed native actions. open opens a carried container; apply does not. dispatched means the handler returned, not that the desired effect happened. Storage and trading are unsupported.
executor_contract.knowledge: Descriptions preserve unidentified names and confusion. Missing information stays unknown. Abilities and ranged-fire commands are not supported by this executor; do not plan to invoke them.
executor_contract.history: Past observations are not current facts. An unseen enemy may remain nearby. executed:false may still spend time/energy. Re-evaluate failures rather than blindly retrying.
executor_contract.hazards: derived.hazards is an ordinal review priority, not damage or death probability. Use actual effects, their details, and combinations with hostiles/HP/open liquid terrain. Unknown is not harmless. Body/equipment coating, dried stains, terrain liquid and carried containers differ. Wait uses native firefighting when aflame or warms the player when frozen; inspect the actual outcome. Cleaning and active abilities are not supported actions.
executor_contract.map: 25 rows, 80 columns, x right and y down. Every character, including legacy control glyphs, occupies one cell; do not count visually rendered columns. derived.map_markers gives stair coordinates from observed terrain when available, otherwise displayed glyphs. Remembered stairs may be stale. Overlays such as @ can hide them; absence does not prove no stairs. Spaces may be unexplored; glyphs are display evidence, not a pathfinding oracle. Creature coordinates override glyphs.
executor_contract.mapping: spatial.visibility: v currently visible, m explored but unseen, u unexplored. spatial.terrain: ? unknown, . no visible static obstruction, # visible solid, + door, ~ open liquid, < up stairs, > down stairs. No hidden objects are inspected; clear is not a guarantee of passability or safety. derived.mapping is shared zone memory, including prior observed terrain, arrivals, failed routes, frontier cells beside unknown terrain, and known path distances. Prefer path distance over straight-line distance around walls. High visit counts help detect loops, but backtracking for safety or return remains valid. Native goto/explore uses the game engine and stops on danger.
executor_contract.conversation: An option labelled ... continues the NPC's speech. Cancel closes the conversation without advancing its branch. When seeking a quest, continue listening and accept the offered work before ending. Submitted modal responses document what was sent; their acknowledgements and subsequent observations establish what happened. Candidate IDs are scoped to this request, never reuse an ID from a past plan.

mapping.meaning: Terrain: ? unknown, . no visible static obstruction, # visible solid, + door, ~ liquid, < up, > down. Stored terrain may be stale outside current visibility; it is not guaranteed passability. Visits count observed arrivals, not intermediate macro steps. Frontiers border unknown terrain; dead ends use known eight-neighbor connectivity. Paths exclude known solids, doors, liquids and policy exclusions; they do not prove safety.

hazards.scale: 0 routine, 1 contextual, 2 caution, 3 urgent, 4 critical; heuristic, not a probability

matches.reason: World-map fast travel is unavailable until orientation is recovered.

coverage.limits: Index coverage is not complete coverage of runtime effects, procedural cooking, mods, translated aliases, gas density or all tonic interactions.

survival.meaning: Observed net HP loss per operation, not a damage ceiling. Healing descriptions are candidate evidence, not approval; inspect side effects and current hazards.
